name: prone-right

RIGHT PROFILE, nose and toes facing image RIGHT. Use reference only for identity, NOT its four-view layout. Head to image LEFT, legs to image RIGHT. View from the specified character direction in a low three-quarter overhead dungeon billboard view, NOT top-down.
